items.question: 15일 전 모바일 기기의 결제 완료 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= current_date - INTERVAL '15 days'
  AND timestamp <  current_date - INTERVAL '14 days'
  AND device_type = 'mobile'
  AND event_name = 'is_payment';

items.question: 최근 7일 일별 문의 접수 건수 추이는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    summary_date,
    event_count AS contact_submissions
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE
    event_name = 'contact_submit'
    AND summary_date >= current_date - 7
    AND summary_date < current_date
ORDER BY summary_date;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 기기 유형별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    device_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date) THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS this_week_sessions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date) - INTERVAL '7 days'
             AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date) THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS last_week_sessions
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 nov_mega_sale 캠페인 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT 'recent_7d' AS period, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
  AND summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date

UNION ALL

SELECT 'previous_7d' AS period, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
  AND summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date < current_date - 7

ORDER BY period;

items.question: 최근 28일 주말(토·일)과 평일의 하루 평균 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM summary_date)::int IN (0,6) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
    AVG(daily_sessions)::numeric AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM (
    SELECT summary_date, SUM(sessions) AS daily_sessions
    FROM agg_user_session_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
      AND summary_date < current_date
    GROUP BY summary_date
) AS d
GROUP BY day_type
ORDER BY day_type;

items.question: 15일 전과 14일 전의 기기 유형별 결제 완료 건수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    device_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(timestamp) = current_date - 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payments_15_days_ago,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(timestamp) = current_date - 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payments_14_days_ago
FROM events
WHERE
    event_name = 'is_payment'
    AND timestamp >= current_date - 15
    AND timestamp < current_date - 13
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 지난달과 이번 달의 일평균 페이지뷰를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT period,
       avg_daily_pageviews
FROM (
    SELECT 'last_month' AS period,
           AVG(daily_views) AS avg_daily_pageviews
    FROM (
        SELECT summary_date,
               SUM(page_views) AS daily_views
        FROM agg_page_daily
        WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '1 month'
          AND summary_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)
        GROUP BY summary_date
    ) lm
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'this_month' AS period,
           AVG(daily_views) AS avg_daily_pageviews
    FROM (
        SELECT summary_date,
               SUM(page_views) AS daily_views
        FROM agg_page_daily
        WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
          AND summary_date <= current_date
        GROUP BY summary_date
    ) tm
) sub
ORDER BY period;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 전환 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7
                 AND summary_date <  current_date THEN conversions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS recent_conversions,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 14
                 AND summary_date <  current_date - 7 THEN conversions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS previous_conversions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date <  current_date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY traffic_source;

items.question: 최근 14일 일별 모바일과 데스크톱 세션 수를 날짜별 한 행에 나란히 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    summary_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_type = 'mobile'  THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_sessions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_type = 'desktop' THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS desktop_sessions
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date <  current_date
GROUP BY summary_date
ORDER BY summary_date;

items.question: 지난주 세션 200개 이상인 유입 소스(traffic_source) 중 결제한 세션 비율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
    SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
    ROUND(SUM(conversions)::numeric * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source
HAVING SUM(sessions) >= 200
ORDER BY conversion_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 3;
